packageRules.description: Solo project: fold every non-major update into one PR per ecosystem to keep review noise down. Majors stay separate so they get read.
GitHub Actions are tag-pinned across both CI workflows; keep them current as one PR.
Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 are deliberate ADR-pinned majors (ADR 0014). Label their major bumps so they're never merged on autopilot.
